name: Chill Medicated | On The Go 150mg 1:1 | Extreme X
description:
Dosage: 150mg THC : 150mg CBD

Activation Time: 10 - 15 minutes 

Our plant-based premium product is sourced, produced, and tested in Michigan. Our topical is non-transdermal, meaning it does not get you high, making it the perfect fit for all day use in any environment. Apply the balm directly to the affected area, gently massage until completely absorbed. Store the container in cooler temperatures and keep out of direct sunlight.
